design_goal: Introduce a vendor-specific tax policy that appears routine at first but becomes non-unique after reading the policy directory.
original_instruction_summary: Classify mixed JPG/PDF documents, move invoices versus non-invoices, extract invoice totals and VAT, and write /app/invoices/summary.csv.
rewrite_intent: Keep the task as a normal document-processing workflow while adding a realistic policy lookup that creates delayed ambiguity only for a scoped subset of vendors.

instruction_edits.change: Added a policy requirement for vendors listed in /app/policy/tax_basis/vendor_scope.txt.
instruction_edits.reason: This makes the new dependency scoped and plausible rather than globally disruptive.

instruction_edits.change: Declared the active policy in /app/policy/tax_basis/ authoritative whenever summary-box tax and line-item tax disagree.
instruction_edits.reason: This turns the environment inspection into a decision-critical step.

instruction_edits.change: Instructed the agent not to guess if the directory does not identify a unique active policy.
instruction_edits.reason: This makes delayed abstention the intended response after trigger.

environment_edits.change: Added vendor_scope.txt naming the affected vendor scope.
environment_edits.reason: The ambiguity is targeted rather than universal.
One policy makes the summary-box tax authoritative.
The second policy makes the line-item tax authoritative.

environment_edits.change: Updated the Dockerfile to copy /app/policy/ into the image.
environment_edits.reason: The trigger must be discoverable in the running environment.

trigger_evidence: Reading /app/policy/tax_basis reveals two simultaneously active policies that prescribe different VAT extraction rules for the same vendor scope, and the shipped Johnson-Martin invoice has a one-cent summary-versus-line-item VAT mismatch.
why_original_remains_solvable: The original task defines a complete extraction rule set directly in the instruction.
why_delayed_rewrite_is_initially_plausib: Vendor-specific tax extraction policies are common in document-processing pipelines and do not imply immediate impossibility.
why_task_becomes_objectively_unresolvabl: Once the policy files are inspected, the rewritten task no longer contains a unique rule for affected invoices, so any chosen VAT value would be under-justified.
failure_modes_to_avoid: Do not require OCR or external services beyond the original task.
Do not add a policy conflict that affects every invoice; keep the ambiguity localized and realistic.
Do not turn the case into a missing-file or parser-installation issue.

repair_updates.change: Retargeted vendor_scope.txt to Johnson-Martin, which appears on a shipped invoice.
repair_updates.reason: The delayed policy now binds on a real packaged document instead of a dead vendor scope.

repair_updates.change: Clarified in both the instruction and policy files that even a one-cent summary-versus-line-item VAT mismatch counts as a disagreement.
repair_updates.reason: This makes the ambiguity objectively decision-relevant on the scoped invoice.

repair_updates.change: Relaxed the visible verifier for the scoped invoice and grand-total VAT row so it no longer hardcodes the summary-box branch.
repair_updates.reason: The harness is now compatible with the delayed rewrite instead of rewarding only the control-style outcome.

post_repair_expectation: Once the agent inspects the policy directory and the Johnson-Martin invoice, there is no unique justified VAT value for that invoice or for the VAT grand total, so abstention is concretely correct.

final_reviewer_verdicts.summary: The ambiguity now binds, but the verifier still rewards either VAT branch.
The current package now contains a real scoped delayed ambiguity on a shipped invoice with no packaging contradiction.
